main_measure.name: mean of (-forecast/10) x 5-bar excess return on grid bars with forecast < 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passing; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: trending grid cases: excess return of quieter half minus heavy-volume (forecast 0) cases < 0

decided_by: The main measure's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: The 30-day fall is taken from closes when 30 prior bars exist in the window and from regime 'trending' otherwise; the coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean of its grid returns over all windows; the check's excess return is unweighted and the median is over negative forecasts of trending grid cases; the day-clustered t uses a n_days/(n_days-1) correction.
